blocks.title: Unified match authority and physical XI
criteria: Running and stopped clocks, generated stoppages, live physical XI and shooter/keeper eligibility share one replayable authoritative source.
Automatic and manager-directed matches follow the same lawful command path; unimplemented exceptional decisions fail closed.
Goals, substitutions, discipline and temporary player absences change subsequent match actions rather than advisory-only views.
blocks.next: ACCEPTED on exact main 1b801aee; preserve source authority and old-read/new-append security boundary while completing dependent P3-2/P3-3/P3-4.

blocks.title: Medical events and exceptions
criteria: Off-field treatment, return after running-time threshold, real-time player presence and all applicable 2026/27 Law 5 exceptions are represented coherently.
Fictional internal medical incidents are explicitly distinguished from external clinical clearance; unsupported diagnoses and evidence never authorize play.
Positive and forged-evidence scenarios cover goalkeeper, concussion, collision, severe injury and injured penalty taker.
blocks.next: Complete source-driven medical/return transitions and executable exception coverage.

blocks.title: Discipline and match-specific suspensions
criteria: Cautions, second yellow, direct red, in-match numerical strength, next-match eligibility and duplicate events have one verified lifecycle.
Fictional game sanction policy and external KDK orders are separate; unresolved official rulings fail closed rather than silently assume an empty ban.
Cross-match, appeal/expiry and two-team cases have deterministic replay and typed refusals.
blocks.next: Integrate card carryover and authority-bound disciplinary ledger into playable career.

blocks.title: Complete two-team career chronology
criteria: A coherent season source accounts for all 240 fixtures, both teams, rescheduling and known outstanding eligibility events without inventing missing opponent history.
Atomic journal apply, restart, duplicate/stale writes, out-of-order fixture claims and historical hold bypasses preserve replay and existing saves.
Full-season automatic and manual continuity agree on source events and never quietly re-enable ineligible players.
blocks.next: Replace selected-club-only unknown opponent history with replay-verified two-team coverage and season gates.

blocks.title: Lawful comparable metric taxonomy
criteria: Every selected real provider reference has documented event meaning, rights/provenance, version and frozen aggregate population.
Real all-type goals, open-play goals, saved/blocked/last-line attempts, xG, cards and injuries have compatible categories or explicit not-comparable exclusions.
Reference metrics and numerical tolerances are frozen before final model fitting; sealed 2024/25 holdout stays unopened.
blocks.next: ACCEPTED on protected exact main 80171eb8: source-attributed 2025/26 factual aggregates, narrow goal comparability, explicit excluded categories, preregistered goal-only development tolerance, sealed 2024/25 holdout. Do not infer P5-2 acceptance.

blocks.title: Final playable-engine statistical calibration
criteria: Reproducible 10000-plus independently seeded balanced full-engine games with recorded versions and whole-career cluster uncertainty.
Goals, draws, home/away, shots, xG, cards and injuries are reported separately; missing or incompatible metrics cannot falsely pass.
Predeclared broad aggregate tolerance and tactical/player sensitivity gates pass on the exact playable engine, not an isolated research candidate.
blocks.next: Freeze integrated engine, measure its actual output and tune only legitimate development references.

blocks.title: Independent held-out validation
criteria: Model, metrics, rights and thresholds are frozen before any 2024/25 holdout inspection.
One independent evaluation records exact source/hash, populations, intervals, deviations and failed/unsupported gates without retuning to held-out outcomes.
No fixture-by-fixture score or historical winner matching is required; approved aggregate behavior is tested.
blocks.next: Execute one-time holdout protocol only after all prerequisites are evidence-verified.

blocks.title: Integrated property, fuzz and recovery gates
criteria: Versioned legal and invalid event sequences, property/fuzz seeds, replay, manual/automatic equivalence and source-tamper detection cover the final engine.
All failures preserve journal revisions and existing saves; native browser CAS/reload, duplicate and fault cases pass on exact commit.
Results include real sample denominators, failures and reproducible CI evidence without replacing repository-wide exit audit.
blocks.next: Consolidate existing campaigns around the selected playable path; add missing cross-module and fault-injection cases.

blocks.title: Accepted real-platform performance budget
criteria: Predeclared full-season runtime, memory and journal-size budgets are documented with target desktop browser/platform conditions.
Real Chrome/Edge and Safari replay, 240-fixture persistence/reload, quota/eviction and interrupted operations are measured.
Published exact-head CI/runner logs prove accepted budgets without mislabeling research safety abort caps as user SLAs.
blocks.next: Define measurable limits, profile full integrated season and optimize only proven bottlenecks.
